mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (indicating monetary easing) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is declining, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% triggers expectations of monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 (YoY).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing expansion regime (HOUST > 1400), rising housing starts signal strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers recessionary expectations, increasing risk aversion and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0.
